convention.frame: x forward, y left, z up, metres; the hull box is centred on x = 0, y = 0 and stands on z = 0
convention.hull_box: the top is max(the real hull or turret roof, the top of the tallest bulky dressing - 0.3 m) (decisions.md C4, after F-B1). Sights, sensors, radars and roof guns that are not a roster mount are dressing, held to unitArt.ts's 0.3 m bulky / 0.15 m thin allowance. The box covers the body, including an armoured turret overhang (FC8)
convention.pivot: the centre of the turret ring; for a fixed mount, the trunnion or hinge it is drawn on (only pivot + muzzle reaches the simulation)
convention.muzzle: muzzle_m is measured from the mount's pivot: the simulation fires from pivot + muzzle (crates/sim/src/weapons/muzzle.rs:12-22; decisions.md C5)
convention.eye: the sight's height over the ground (catalog.rs:181); kept unless a source contradicts it (FA-6)

thresholds.hull_dimension: fix when off by more than max(0.10 m, 3 %)
thresholds.pivot: fix when off by more than 0.15 m on any axis
thresholds.muzzle_point: fix when the world muzzle point (pivot + muzzle) is off by more than 0.15 m on any axis; a value written in another convention is fixed whatever its size (C5)
thresholds.eye_m: kept unless a source contradicts it
thresholds.note: One set for every lane (decisions.md C10). The lanes' own variants (F-A's max(0.10 m, 3 %) for muzzles, F-C's 0.30 m muzzle reach) are retired.

verdicts.keep: the frame number agrees with the references within the thresholds
verdicts.fix: slice 15 changes it to `new`: a row in fix-rows.json, or the parent's row where the fixture takes the field through extends
verdicts.unresolved: kept at today's value: nothing measures it well enough to move it; named
verdicts.art-only: not a frame number: the family slice fixes the art
verdicts.inherits: the fixture extends another unit and this appearance takes its rows

published.source: length_m: KNDS Puma page via Wikipedia; width_m: Wikipedia: 3.7 m base, 4.0 m up-armoured (level C); height_m: Wikipedia (Bundeswehr): 3.6 m for the optics; turret_roof_m: Wikipedia (Bundeswehr): 3.1 m for the turret roof

dressing_conflicts.part: PERI commander's sight on its mast
dressing_conflicts.why: Not dressing today, so it sets the hull top. Marked dressing over a 3.1 m box it breaks both allowances (0.3 m bulky, 0.15 m thin). Same question as the Leopard PERI (slice 07 Q4): slice 15 decides.

art.note: tier 0 of the committed GLB: hull is what fit.hull_extents measures (no gun, hmg or dressing_* subtree); crew and antennas are left out of the dressing column

rows.source: Bundeswehr via Wikipedia: 3.1 m turret roof, 3.6 m to the optics
rows.note: C4: box top = max(roof, tallest bulky dressing - 0.3 m). Roof 3.1 m; the PERI head reaches 3.6 m, so the top is 3.30 m (F-C's 3.1 m left the PERI 0.5 m over it). The art's PERI (3.70 m) comes down 0.1 m, and a non-dressing part (its mast) must reach 3.2 m for the hull fit's 0.1 m tolerance. Lane: 3.6 m is the PERI optics. The art's roof is already 3.11 m, so the hull fit only changes for the PERI (below).
The PERI head is where the commander looks from.

notes.why: Length and width match the published figures; the hull roof and turret roof match too. What reads wrong is the hull's own outline (prow, upper glacis, side modules), slice 27. The height fix is the PERI, not the body.
Side modules (puma.py:85-101) run past the prow; slice 09 side_skirt, adopted in slice 27.

5_mells.answer: No. The MELLS spans y 0.86-1.32 m against the 2.0 m half-width, and x -0.70..0.62 m inside the length. Its top is 3.16 m: 0.06 m over a 3.1 m roof, inside the 0.1 m hull tolerance, and as the launcher mount (on the autocannon) it is measured outside the hull fit anyway (validate.ts OFF_HULL). It sits at the turret's left side, top about level with the roof, as in the photos.
5_mells.frame_change: none for the MELLS; its pivot stays at z 2.95 because the roof does not move.
